Hongyue (Red Moon (Page 22)) Kaiyang knocked the snack shop owner to the ground within two seconds and couldn't get up. When he came back to his senses and looked for Jiayu, he found that there was no one everywhere, and Jiayu's figure was no longer where he was. Wu Qian's carriage continued to move toward As they walked north, the late autumn sun shone on the carriage, leaving a long shadow, which seemed to be pulling Wu Qian. "The situation is not very good. We have taken the best medicine for him!" Bu Yijin said, "My subordinates know, but Qian. How should I respond to the young master? We have already received a deposit of one million from him! If the task cannot be completed, it may affect the reputation of our entire Zhongxin Hall!" Li Jun said with some worry. "You are thinking that your Qiu family will be harmed if you work for me this time. It's a heavy loss, don't you think it's worth it?" Wu Xiuyang said coldly. Aunt Wei is an old man in the palace, and she certainly has some dignity in the hearts of Liuyun Liusu and others. After listening to his words, Leng Yue found that she had lost her composure again, and she couldn't help but There was a burst of anger. He couldn't help but scolded himself in his heart for being so worthless for being embarrassed in front of him again and again. When Yun Chen saw this, he slightly raised the corners of his mouth and moved his palms, but Yun Chen also used the magical power of the Great Sage Yuan Palm. The Great Saint Yuan Palm used is powerful, full of holy power, and powerful. Compared with Sheng Tianya's Great Saint Yuan Palm, it is more like an authentic holy art. "Bloodthirst and violent temper are good, but Warcraft has another biggest characteristic..." A flash of light flashed on Linglong's face. Blushing. Many young geniuses stopped what they were doing. They all looked into the distance in shock, obviously very surprised. Xuexian also nodded and said: "Thank you, junior brother! Okay, you guys sit down first, I will prepare the food and drinks." Xuexian turned and left. It's a rare trip for you. After returning home, you can tell your neighbors about your experiences in the capital. "Sister Ji Jinhua was quite embarrassed. When they came, their brother's family paid for the travel expenses.
